segment_captions.caption: C walks towards the water bowl while the white dog drinks from it. The brown dog approaches the water bowl and starts drinking as well.
C stands in a green plastic kiddie pool filled with water, splashing around with its front paws. The dog continues to play in the pool, occasionally lifting its head out of the water.
C walks away from the green water bowl after stepping out of it. A white dog approaches the bowl.
C walks past a green plastic tub filled with water while a white dog sniffs around it. The brown dog continues walking away from the tub.
C stands near a green plastic pool, observing a white dog that approaches and sniffs the pool. The dog then turns and walks away from the pool towards the right side of the frame.
C walks away from the green plastic pool while a dog lies on the grass nearby.
A dog walks past a green plastic kiddie pool in a grassy yard. A small white dog stands near a fence in the background.
